people.name: Jezebel
people.line: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

translations.web: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad, that you eat no bread?”
translations.bsb: Soon his wife Jezebel came in and asked, “Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?”
